scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
Welcome to Moscovia
Here is the paradise spreading on
the endless seas
You'll be happy with the beautiful
scenery and the sunlight!
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
欢迎来到莫斯科比亚。
这里是延伸至无尽大海的乐园。
美丽的风景和明媚的阳光，一定会让您感到愉悦！

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
I was sent from Moscovia Palace
to guide tourists and to give them
information on this town.
If you have some questions, please ask me.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
我是受莫斯科比亚宫殿之命，前来为游客提供向导和资讯的。
如果您有任何问题，请尽管问我。

scripts.text: Delete all the marks on the mini-map.
scripts.translation: 清除小地图上的所有标记

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
Where would you like to go?
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
您想去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
The Palace can be found ^ff0000+^000000 at the
end of the North sea from
Rune-Midgarts.
There resides our Lord the Czar of
Moscovia and his retainers.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
宫殿位于从卢恩·米德加兹向北航行至北海尽头的^ff0000+^000000方向。
那里居住着莫斯科比亚的君主——沙皇陛下及其侍从。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
The Armor Shop is located at the
southwest corner of town..
You can buy armor made by the best
craftsmen of Moscovia there.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
防具店位于城镇的西南角。
在那里，您可以购买由莫斯科比亚顶尖工匠打造的防具。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
The Tool Shop is located just south
from the center of town.
You can find all sorts of things
you need for your travels.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
工具店位于城镇中心的正南方。
在那里，您可以找到旅行所需的各种物品。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
The Inn 'Sticky Herb Tree' is just
north from the center of town.
If you need to rest, there is no
better place to stay.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
旅店“粘粘的草树”位于城镇中心的正北方。
如果您需要休息，那里是最佳的住宿地点。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
I've deleted all marks on the mini-map.
Whenever you'd like to put marks
there, you can ask me.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
我已经清除了小地图上的所有标记。
如果您想添加标记，随时可以来找我。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia Guide]
It'd be great to walk about alone.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亚向导]
独自漫步也是一种享受。
请多保重。
